mode.story.desc: The campaign: 6 sectors, 24 stages, a boss at the end of every sector - and the truth about the Loop.
mode.endless.desc: Survive as long as you can. The level rises every 40 seconds, the sector changes every 3 levels and a boss drops in every 6.
mode.time_attack.desc: You have 3 minutes. Fragments and kills buy you time, every level asks for more. How far can you get?
mode.boss_rush.desc: Only bosses, one after the other, with a visit to the shop between fights. Stronger every lap.
mode.horde.desc: Ten waves of enemies and a plasma mace. Swing it to smash enemies and reflect bullets.

help.text: Collect the golden fragments to fill the SYNC bar. Every sector has its own enemies and hazards, and every fourth stage is a boss fight.
Kills and fragments build a COMBO - getting hit breaks it. Bullets that just miss you (grazes) charge the PULSE: press Space when it is ready to wipe every bullet and blast nearby enemies.
The dash makes you invulnerable for a moment: use it to cut through a wall of bullets. Spend the coins you collect in the Arsenal between stages.
Playing alone? The arrow keys and Enter also control Player 1, so you can play with the keyboard only.

tips: Dashing makes you invulnerable for a split second. Use it to cross a wall of bullets.
Every graze charges the PULSE. Get close - but not too close.
A hit resets your combo. Sometimes patience is worth more than points.
Walls stop bullets. Use them as cover.
Laser sights and dashed lines are warnings: look where the sweep will end.
Hearts drop more often when you are hurt.
Comets charge in a straight line. Sidestep at the last moment.
Lancers show a laser sight before firing. Break the line of sight.
Splitters break in two when destroyed. Keep your distance.
Bosses drop a heart and a power-up whenever they change phase.
The pulse also erases enemy bullets: save it for the worst moment.
Upgrades bought in the Arsenal stay with you until the story ends.
